title: [Feature Request]: add top_p and temperature parameters to OpenAIAssistantAgent
body:
### Feature Description

I’d like to suggest adding support for the top_p and temperature parameters to the OpenAIAssistantAgent. These parameters are available in the OpenAI library for a while now and they're compatible with version of openai library llamaindex is on right now.

If this is OK, I’d like to work on adding it.

### Reason

_No response_

_No response_
